name: dcepa95
description: Pick which of dcepa95's plugins to install. Timesheet is on by default; change the choice any time with /plugin configure dcepa95@claude-skills.

timesheet.title: Timesheet (/timesheet:log)
timesheet.description: Rebuilds your worked hours from git and Claude history into a Google Calendar that Productive reads.

standup.title: Standup (/standup:write)
standup.description: Writes your standup, end-of-day or weekly update from your work history. Also installs Timesheet.

ship.title: Ship (/ship:pr)
ship.description: Gets a branch ready for review and writes the PR description in your voice. Also installs TEMP guard.

ticket.title: Ticket (/ticket:plan)
ticket.description: Turns a ticket and its designs into an agreed plan before any code.

design_qa.title: Design QA (/design-qa:check)
design_qa.description: Checks a page or component against its Figma design with measurements and a pixel diff.

temp_guard.title: TEMP guard
temp_guard.description: Blocks Claude from committing or opening PRs while temporary changes are in, and warns about new TODOs.
